department: School of Electrical, Computer, and Biomedical Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the PhD.

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are required with the application.
gre_general.quote: transcripts, official GRE scores, and three reference letters

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission does not depend on a faculty agreement; the student must have an advisor within the first semester.
supervisor.quote: The student must have an advisor with the academic program within the first semester of enrollment

funding.value: The catalog mentions fellowships and scholarships only in general terms.

entry_route.value: A master's is normally required, but outstanding bachelor's applicants can enter directly.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the program will normally require a Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering or a related field

also.quote: Applicants with exceptional research potential or outstanding academic qualifications may be considered for direct entry into the program after completion of a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering

notes: The PhD is run by the same school as the ECE program and shares its GRE and advisor rules.
